learning_objective: 🎯 We will read a beautiful poem about a child's imagination, explore different daily jobs, and understand the feeling of wanting to be totally free!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In the morning, the child sees a hawker selling bangles. The child wishes to be a hawker because he can walk freely anywhere on the road without rushing to school.
In the afternoon, the child sees a gardener playing in the mud. The child wishes to be a gardener so he can get his clothes dirty without anyone scolding him!
At night, the child sees the watchman swinging his lantern in the dark street. The child wishes to be a watchman so he never has to go to sleep early.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Job Roleplay
fun_activity.instructions: Dress up using old clothes and act out your favorite job for 5 minutes. You can be a gardener planting invisible seeds or a watchman with a flashlight!

quick_recap: ⭐ The poem is about a child who watches people doing different jobs.
⭐ The child wishes to have the freedom that the hawker, gardener, and watchman seem to have.
⭐ It is fun to use our imagination to pretend we are doing different things!
